dimensions.summary: Local Capabilities owns one calm OCR selector; existing Paddle install and lifecycle controls remain separate.
API, Settings, UI, architecture and D-20260801-Machine-Local-OCR-Engine-Preference agree on CAS, scope and fallback behavior.
Direct schema, service, IPC, router and Settings tests prove an actual feature without claiming P5 or PIGE-INGEST-004 completion.
A bounded preference owner composes with the existing OCR adapter router and leaves install, tool leases and artifacts with their current owners.
Existing API, Settings, UI and architecture owners plus one durable Decision absorb the feature without a new design document.
